author: Microsoft
name: iOS Background Download Extension
description: A .NET iOS downloader extension for self-hosted Background Assets packs. The system manages the downloads.

postActions.description: Add the extension to the containing app

manualInstructions.text: In the app project, add a ProjectReference to iOSBackgroundDownloadExtension1.csproj with IsAppExtension set to true. Configure the app for self-hosted Background Assets with system-managed downloads, and use the same app group in the app and the extension. See https://github.com/dotnet/macios/blob/main/dotnet/Templates/README.md#background-download-extension.

bundleId.description: The bundle identifier of the app that contains the extension

appGroupId.description: The app group shared by the app and the extension

minOSVersion.description: Overrides SupportedOSPlatformVersion in the project file (must be 26.0 or later)

extensionClassName.description: The downloader class name, used in [Register] and EXPrincipalClass

Framework.description: The target framework for the project.
